pages.title: Back to the Deep
pages.text: A serviced submarine becomes useful for deep-sea expeditions again.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Find damaged submarines in Abyssal Ruins. The separate assembly route is a copper cube around an Enigmatic Engine with six Depth Glass blocks at the front. Both routes retain real engine acquisition, never a free reward.

pages.title: Field notes
pages.text: Find the abyss beneath oceans: trenches, vented seamounts, whalefalls and ruins give distinct landmarks. Muck slows walking.
